en:
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.

<CLT=cltMIND>I thought we had just come a little closer
to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>end<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>But we're still struggling.
Wandering in the darkness.

<CLT=cltMIND>is fueling this killing game.
Just like Kokichi...
